explanation.text: The Logic: Source p.21 states that non-financial or real investments include real estate, gold, and commodities. Source p.13 reinforces this by distinguishing physical assets such as gold, precious metals, and real estate from financial assets. The Trap: Commercial paper, G-Secs, and money-market instruments are financial/debt instruments, not real assets per pp.13 and 21. Note: The split between real and financial assets in pp.13 and 21-23 drives the classification.
